import numpy as np


def test_install():
    print("numpy version:", np.__version__)
    assert isinstance(np.__version__, str)


def test_creation_and_dtype():
    a = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4], dtype=np.int64)
    assert a.shape == (4,)
    assert a.dtype == np.int64
    b = np.zeros((2, 3))
    assert b.shape == (2, 3) and np.all(b == 0)
    print("creation/shape/dtype OK")


def test_vectorized_ops():
    x = np.arange(5)
    assert np.array_equal(x * 2, np.array([0, 2, 4, 6, 8]))
    assert np.isclose(np.sqrt(16.0), 4.0)
    print("vectorized ops OK")

    print("matrix multiply OK")


def test_broadcasting_and_aggregation():
